x: HRIDAY's 12 cities include Amaravati (AP) and Warangal.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about urban programmes?
o: PM SVANidhi is a scheme of MoHUA
x: HRIDAY covers 12 heritage cities; the Smart Cities Mission covers 100.

s: Which Ministry runs the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)?
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
x: DAY-NULM, for the urban poor, is run by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (earlier Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation).

s: In February 2022, MoHUA approved ₹235 crore for Andhra Pradesh under which goal of SBM-Urban 2.0?
x: MoHUA approved ₹235 crore for AP under 'Garbage free cities', the goal of SBM-Urban 2.0.

s: What is the size of the Urban Challenge Fund under MoHUA for FY 2025-26 to 2030-31?
x: The Urban Challenge Fund is a ₹1 lakh crore Centrally Sponsored Scheme under MoHUA for 2025-26 to 2030-31.

s: PM SVANidhi is a scheme of which Ministry?
x: PM SVANidhi is under MoHUA; PM Vishwakarma is under MSME and PM-AJAY under Social Justice and Empowerment.

s: Who chairs the National Council for Land Reforms, set up in 2008?
x: The National Council for Land Reforms (2008) is chaired by the Prime Minister.

s: SVAMITVA, which gives property cards for village houses through drone surveys, is a scheme of which Ministry?
x: SVAMITVA is under the Ministry of Panchayati Raj and was launched on 24 April 2020, National Panchayati Raj Day.

s: For which purpose is the Hariyali scheme (2003)?
x: Hariyali (2003) is watershed development through Panchayati Raj Institutions.

s: SVAMITVA was launched on 24 April 2020. Which day is observed on that date?
x: SVAMITVA was launched on National Panchayati Raj Day, 24 April 2020.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission:
1. It was launched in 2016.
2. Its Centre-State funding share is 60:40.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: SPMRM (2016) develops 300+ Rurban clusters with 60:40 Centre-State funding.

s: What is the main objective of the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (2000)?
o: All-weather road connectivity to unconnected habitations
x: PMGSY (2000) gives all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations.

s: The Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission revives which idea of Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam?
x: SPMRM ('rural soul, urban amenities') revives Kalam's PURA – Providing Urban Amenities in Rural Areas.

s: Who founded the Institute of Rural Management, Anand (IRMA) in 1979?
x: IRMA, Anand was founded in 1979 by Verghese Kurien.

s: What is the main role of CAPART, set up in 1986?
o: Funding voluntary bodies for rural development projects
x: CAPART (1986) funds voluntary organisations for rural projects.

s: Under which name did the Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme (DILRMP) begin in 2008?
x: DILRMP began as NLRMP in 2008 and became a Central Sector scheme in 2016.

s: Where was the Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission launched on 21 February 2016?
x: SPMRM was launched at Kurubhat in Rajnandgaon district of Chhattisgarh.

s: Which village is known as India's first digital village?
x: Akodara in Sabarkantha district, Gujarat, developed by ICICI Bank, was dedicated to the nation as India's first digital village in 2015.

s: Which is the apex body of Mission Karmayogi?
x: Mission Karmayogi's apex body is the PM's Public HR Council; the Capacity Building Commission and Karmayogi Bharat sit below it.

s: Which SPV runs the iGOT Karmayogi online platform?
x: Karmayogi Bharat, a Section 8 company (2022), runs iGOT Karmayogi.

s: FutureSkills Prime, a reskilling platform in emerging technologies, is a joint initiative of whom?
x: FutureSkills Prime is by MeitY and NASSCOM, delivered with C-DAC and NIELIT centres.

s: Mission Karmayogi seeks to shift civil-service training in which direction?
x: Mission Karmayogi (2020) aims at a shift from rule-based to role-based training.

s: Mission Karmayogi is the popular name of which programme?
o: National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building
x: Mission Karmayogi is the National Programme for Civil Services Capacity Building (NPCSCB), approved on 2 Sep 2020.

s: What is the general Centre-State funding pattern for Centrally Sponsored Schemes?
x: The general pattern is 60:40, with 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States and full central funding for UTs without legislatures.

s: Which one of the following is a Central Sector scheme?
x: PM Vishwakarma is listed as a Central Sector scheme funded and run centrally. DAY-NRLM, PMAY-G and PM-AJAY are Centrally Sponsored examples.

s: Which of the following groups consists entirely of Centrally Sponsored Schemes?
o: DAY-NRLM, VB-G RAM G, PMAY-G and PM-AJAY
SEED, PM Vishwakarma and Urban Challenge Fund only
x: DAY-NRLM, VB-G RAM G, PMAY-G and PM-AJAY are listed as Centrally Sponsored Schemes. PM-KISAN, PM Vishwakarma, DILRMP and SEED are Central Sector examples, while the Urban Challenge Fund is also Centrally Sponsored.

s: Which of the following is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme?
x: DAY-NRLM is Centrally Sponsored; PM-KISAN, PM Vishwakarma and DILRMP (since 2016) are Central Sector.

s: What was the earlier name of the Adarsh Gram component of PM-AJAY?
x: The Adarsh Gram component was formerly PMAGY (2009-10); it covers villages with 500+ people and over 40% SC population.

s: Which one of the following is NOT a benefit associated with PM Vishwakarma?
o: Collateral-free credit up to ₹3 lakh at 5 per cent interest
Working-capital loans beginning at ₹10,000 for street vendors
x: The ₹10,000 working-capital loan is associated with PM SVANidhi. PM Vishwakarma provides the stipend, toolkit support and collateral-free credit mentioned in the other options.

s: Up to what amount do artisans receive toolkit support under PM Vishwakarma?
x: PM Vishwakarma gives artisans in 18 traditional trades a toolkit up to ₹15,000, a ₹500/day training stipend and collateral-free credit up to ₹3 lakh.

s: PMEGP (2008) was formed by merging which schemes?
